headline: College Board Gives First Scholastic Aptitude Test Nationwide
dispatch: Princeton, N.J., June 23 -- The College Board today administered its new Scholastic Aptitude Test to thousands of students across the country, the first time such a standardized examination has been offered for university admissions. Some 8,040 students sat for the test at centers in multiple states. Officials said the examination, divided into verbal and mathematical sections, is intended to give colleges a uniform measure of applicants beyond secondary school grades alone.
answer: First Scholastic Aptitude Test given to students, 1926
